extracted.name: Asian Dipping Sauce
extracted.description: Use garlic and red chile paste to flavor this soy dipping sauce with ketchup, lemon juice, and rice wine vinegar.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon garlic and red chile paste, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Stir water and sugar together in a bowl to dissolve the sugar; add soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, ketchup, lemon juice, garlic and red chile paste, and sesame oil into the water. Stir the mixture until smooth; refrigerate until ready to serve.
